text:
lia_support: Customer reported p95 latency regression on text-generation since 2026-03-15 18:00 UTC. They see token throughput drop and some 5xx spikes. They provided a few request IDs: r_0a1b2c3d, r_5f6e7d8c. Asking for repro-pack to hand to infra.

marta_oncall: Thanks, lia. Can you paste a minimal curl repro and the exact model + params they hit? Need prompt set, concurrency, token counts. Also ask them to attach redwood debug bundle if possible. :mag:

lia_support: Pasting the curl they used (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -H "X-Request-ID: r_0a1b2c3d" \ 
  -d '{"model": "redwood-text-3b", "inputs": "Summarize the following:\n---\n<doc>...500 tokens...</doc>", "max_tokens": 512, "temperature": 0.2}'
```

lia_support: They reported concurrency ~20 simultaneous requests from their app, average input tokens ~400, output ~450. They claim regression started after our infra deploy on 2026-03-15 17:30 UTC.

shawn_infra: Noted. Can we get the exact route they hit? If they used our proxy/edge vs dedicated. Also which region?

lia_support: Route is /v1/generate (hosted). Region us-west2. No dedicated.

sam_devex: Quick ask-list for a proper repro-pack:
- sample prompt set (10 prompts representative) with token counts per prompt
- exact curl + X-Request-ID header values (we need 3–5 request IDs)
- concurrency config (threads, qps) and a short script we can run (wrk/hey/fanout)
- expected vs observed p95/p99 numbers and time window
- upload debug bundle (redwood-agent collect) or enable debug logging for those request IDs

marta_oncall: I'll take infra traces. lia, ask customer to run this small reproduce script with concurrency 20 and 50 reqs per thread, record latencies. Example node script we ask them to run:

```
# pseudocode, fine to paste
for i in range(20):
  spawn(async () => {
    for j in range(50):
      POST /v1/generate with X-Request-ID set to r_custom_<i>_<j>
  })
```

marta_oncall: Also ask them to set header `X-Debug: true` for a short run so we can join logs.

lia_support: Customer ran quick test and attached two more request IDs r_9f8e7d6c and r_ab12cd34. They attached a small sample prompt set (10 prompts) as a file link: s3://redwood-debug/acme/promptset-20260315.txt (they said private).

shawn_infra: Pulling logs for r_0a1b2c3d and r_9f8e7d6c now. Early glance: saw some tokenization overhead spikes and queuing on the model pool. Logging snippet for r_0a1b2c3d:

```
[2026-03-15T17:35:12Z] request-id=r_0a1b2c3d route=/v1/generate recv 10ms queue_wait=312ms model=redwood-text-3b batch_id=b-733
[2026-03-15T17:35:12Z] request-id=r_0a1b2c3d runtime_infer=820ms kv_cache_load=5ms tokens_in=400 tokens_out=450
[2026-03-15T17:35:13Z] request-id=r_0a1b2c3d send=7ms
```

shawn_infra: Queue wait 312ms is concerning. Batching size around 8 for that batch. We had autoscaler events around 17:32 that didn't fully match traffic spike.

sam_devex: For the repro pack please include: the exact prompt set file (paste contents or attach), a short load script (we prefer hey or vegeta) and specify sequence lengths. Example vegeta attack spec for 20 concurrency: 

```
echo '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate","header":{"Authorization":"Bearer REDACTED","Content-Type":"application/json"},"body":"{\"model\":\"redwood-text-3b\",\"inputs\":\"<PROMPT>\",\"max_tokens\":512}"}' | vegeta attack -duration=30s -rate=20 | vegeta report
```

lia_support: Customer uploaded debug bundle to our temp bucket redwood-debug-bundles/1710601234-acme.tar.gz and gave us access. They also ran vegeta with concurrency 20 and observed p95 jump from 420ms -> 1.2s after the deploy.

marta_oncall: Good. I'll correlate autoscaler logs and kernel selection timeline. shawn, can you dump model pool occupancy and quantization variant used (fp16 vs int8) around that time?

shawn_infra: On it. Early note: model variant used was fp16, but one batch used int8 fallback for one node due to mem pressure. That can explain increased runtime for some sequences because int8 path currently has colder kernel paths.

sam_devex: Action items for customer-facing repro-pack we should request (I'll template message):
1) 10 representative prompts (paste in thread) + token counts per prompt
2) Exact curl or client snippet(s) with X-Request-ID for at least 5 requests spanning regression window
3) A short load script (vegeta/hey) they used or willing to run with concurrency 1/5/20/50 to reproduce throughput curve
4) Their observed p50/p95/p99 numbers and timestamps
5) Debug bundle upload + confirmation of upload path

lia_support: Sending customer the template now. I'll CC infra and devex.

deploy-bot: [deploy] infra/serve:healthcheck rolled at 2026-03-15T17:30:45Z by marta_oncall :white_check_mark:

marta_oncall: After we gather repro pack, plan: attempt reproduce in staging with same model version and warm cache (pre-warm with 200 requests) and run load curve. If we hit regression, bisect deploy (rollback) or pin quantization.

lia_support: Customer replied they will paste prompts and run vegeta with the attack spec, will upload bundle to the S3 path above by EOD. I'll update thread when done. :thumbsup:

shawn_infra: If they can't reproduce, ask them to run with exact tokenization step we provide: `python -c "from redwood_tokenizer import encode; print(len(encode(open('prompt.txt').read())))"` so we have token counts exactly.

sam_devex: Perfect. Once we have the pack, we should create an internal reproducibility issue with attach debug bundle and include these steps. I'll prepare the template repro issue.

lia_support: Thanks team — I'll follow up after bundle is uploaded.
